findings.text: the convergence guard skips unless jax.default_backend() == 'gpu', so it cannot redden the CPU paired suite the node's baseline_suite/after_suite arms run; the only arm the guard fires on is the separately submitted H200 job, and a regression reintroduced on a CPU lane would pass the paired suite silently.

the split-polygon area carries a NaN JVP in the no-four-crossing branch (docs/research/certificate-550-convergence.html stage table, 'Split polygon area' row), recorded by the worker but not repaired; it does not enter cells 61 or 508, so it is outside this node's measured defect, but it is a latent derivative defect of the same class and is named for a separate node.

justifications.fit: kernel.py:386 uses jnp.where on the same diverted predicate that already selects boundary on kernel.py:387, introducing no plan, version or ticket token in any name or comment.
